description_zh: 导入 UPM 用户 VHD
name: ImportDrive

parameters.help_en: The region of the target UPM
parameters.help_zh: 目标 UPM 所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The target UPM domain ID. For workspace scenarios, use the UpmDomainId instead of the NAS file system ID
parameters.help_zh: 目标 UPM Domain ID；工作区场景使用 UpmDomainId，不是 NAS 文件系统 ID
parameters.name: domain_id

parameters.help_en: The target ECD end user ID. The caller account is obtained from the authentication context
parameters.help_zh: 目标 ECD 终端用户 ID；调用方账号从认证上下文取得
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The target platform. Valid values: WINDOWS_10, WINDOWS_11, WINDOWS_SERVER_2019, WINDOWS_SERVER_2022, and WINDOWS_SERVER_2025
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en: The relative path of the cloud application UPM. It must be the same as the path specified during upload authorization. For cloud desktops, do not pass this parameter or pass an empty value
parameters.help_zh: 云应用 UPM 相对路径；必须与上传授权时一致，云桌面不传或传空
parameters.name: mount_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to force an update. Default value: false. If the file already exists and this parameter is set to false, the request fails. If this parameter is set to true, the original DriveId is reused for the update
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制更新，默认 false；已存在时 false 返回失败，true 复用原 DriveId 更新
parameters.name: force_update

Code.description_en: The modification result. A value of `success` indicates success. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Code.description_zh: 修改结果。返回`success`表示成功，否则将返回错误信息
Code.example: 响应代码，200 表示成功。

DriveId.description_en: The newly created or reused target drive ID. A success response only indicates that the import task has been accepted
DriveId.description_zh: 新建或复用的目标 Drive ID；成功仅表示导入任务受理
DriveId.title_en: 新建或复用的目标 Drive ID；成功仅表示导入任务受理
DriveId.title_zh: 新建或复用的目标 Drive ID；成功仅表示导入任务受理

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。取值：true：成功。false：失败
